:::{#exr-diagonal-entries-practice}
#### Adding the diagonal entries of a square matrix

The [sum](algebra-sums.qmd#def-summation) of the [diagonal entries](#def-diagonal-entry) of a [square matrix](#def-square-matrix)
summarizes that [matrix](#def-matrix) in one number,
called its [trace](linear-algebra-special-matrices.qmd#def-trace).
Let

$$
\matr{F} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 5 & -1 \\ 0 & -3 & 8 \\ 4 & 1 & 6 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

Find the sum of the diagonal entries of $\matr{F}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Find the [main diagonal](#def-main-diagonal) of $\matr{F}$ first.

:::
